track: LOCAL-005 independent original compiled platform profile-creation cross-process race reproduction
approach: Execute real LocalProfileStore in a separate net8 executable with a second process holding the final profile.id empty and exclusively open for either short or beyond original 99x10ms reader limit; distinguish finite writer/readers from permanent corruption, without editing T4-owned platform runtime or smoke suite.
hypothesis: The original ~1s retry window can fail a legitimate first-launch reader if the exclusive writer process holds a visible empty profile.id beyond 99 attempts; the same original code succeeds for a short holder and rejects permanent corruption without overwriting.
next_step: Implement deterministic actual separate-process source harness with bounded waits and safe aggregate outcomes; run isolated CPU CI, classify exact failure, hand off to T4 before any production change.
